question: Which of the following was the first state to be annexed into the British empire under the Doctrine of Lapse introduced by Lord Dalhousie?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Satara__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first state to be annexed into the British empire under the Doctrine of Lapse was **Satara**, in the year **1848**.
 
• The Doctrine of Lapse was introduced by **Lord Dalhousie.**
 
• The **Doctrine of lapse** stated that: 
 
 
• The ruler of any princely state which governed directly or indirectly by the British does not have a legal male heir then his state will be annexed by the British.
 
• Adopted sons are not accepted as legal heirs of the policy.
 
 
 
• The scheme was the British annexation policy without a direct, natural, or adopted heir which was how the British acquire the many Indian States.
 
• The states that were annexed, followed by Satara were Jaitpur and Sambalpur(1849), Bhagat(1850), Udaipur(1852), Jhansi(1853), and Nagpur(1854).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lord Dalhousie was the Governor General of India from 1848-1856.
 
• He also introduced the Doctrine of Good of Governed under which Awadh and Punjab were annexed.
 
• Dalhousie established Public Works Department, the objective behind the formation of this department was the construction and maintenance of canals, roads, bridges, etc.
 
• Lord Dalhousie asserted that the western way of ruling was better than the eastern.
